title: A Continuous Relaxation of Quantization-Aware Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.27056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization is a critical piece of the deployment pipeline in the era of large generative models. Low-bit quantization, particularly 2-bits or sub-2-bits, is a notoriously difficult problem, particularly when using a channelwise quantization scheme which has been shown as a leading candidate for hardware-efficiency. The key challenges with low-bit quantization range from limited quantization levels to saddle points or flat regions in the loss surface. In this paper, we look at the problem of flat quantization loss surfaces through a lens of dynamically changing bitwidth. Unlike existing techniques which either change the bit-precision abruptly or keep it fixed, we propose to gradually alter the bitwidth as the model trains. To this end, we propose RelaxQAT, a continuous relaxation of the QAT process. We also provide simple theoretical and empirical insights behind why RelaxQAT helps the QAT performance. translated_title: 感知量化训练的连续松弛方法
translated_abstract: 量化是大生成模型时代部署流程中的关键环节。低位量化，特别是2比特或低于2比特的量化，是一个众所周知的难题，尤其是在使用逐通道量化方案时——该方案已被证明是硬件效率方面的领先候选方案。低位量化的主要挑战包括量化级别有限以及损失曲面中存在的鞍点或平坦区域。在本文中，我们通过动态变化位宽的视角来审视量化损失曲面平坦化的问题。与现有技术要么突然改变位精度、要么保持位精度固定不变不同，我们提出在模型训练过程中逐渐改变位宽。为此，我们提出了RelaxQAT，一种QAT（感知量化训练）过程的连续松弛方法。我们还提供了简单的理论和实证见解，解释了为什么RelaxQAT能够提升QAT性能。我们广泛的实验证明……
tldr: 提出RelaxQAT，通过在训练过程中逐渐连续地改变位宽来松弛感知量化训练，从而避免低位量化中损失曲面的鞍点和平坦区域问题，显著提升量化模型性能。
